$comment: Org -> payload class. The equip skill reads THIS to decide what a repo may receive; it never infers from folder names or who happens to have access. Any org not listed here falls to `default` (tooling only, zero brand) and the PR body must state why. Addresses SpecFlow findings C1/C2.

Norfolk-Group.label: Norfolk's own org — full kit including internal docs and Norfolk brand.

KIT-Capital.label: Client org. Tooling plus KIT Capital's own marks only. No Norfolk-internal material.

ricardo-cidale-personal.label: Personal account — tooling only, no brand of any kind.

default.label: Org not in the mapping (fork, no remote, multiple remotes, or a new org). Tooling only, zero brand, and the PR says so. Add the org here deliberately to grant more.
